coverage_assessment: Twenty one-query searches cover English/Russian/Turkmen terms, all English and Russian January weekly windows, and December/February boundaries. The Turkmen-language search returned no new clearly relevant January public-gathering lead. The documented first pass is not exhaustive. CABAR and linked Fergana report a 21 December 2020 Mary city protest by about 50 women; Fergana describes that gathering's departure the same day, but does not establish its relation to E005 or other later activity. Both reports cite Azatlyk and are not independent. S035 is a February 2017 out-of-period housing protest. S041 is a distinct 10 February 2021 Shatlyk gathering and is not linked to January's Bayramali queues. S036 repeats E002 while citing Chronicles. S027 is blocked by Cloudflare after a single exact request; no date or body details are available. S043 and S033 were opened as 29–30 August 2012 reports on wage disputes, outside the unit month; their overlapping reporting origins are not independently established. S038 reports Bayramali queues on 5–6 January and credits Radio Azatlyk correspondents, but it does not establish a protest, turnout, explicit demand, or continuity with E005's 8 January observation. Four January candidates remain, with two pending_evidence; E003's physical date and turnout remain unresolved. No exhaustive coverage claim is made.
